title: Blood Blade
summary: Surrounded by scavenging ghouls, Ha-Jun unleashes the primary combat form of the Ring of Hollow Blood—condensing his own fluid blood into the razor-sharp crystalline katana: The Sanguine Fang.

panels.action: Two remaining ghouls crawl along opposite walls, their jagged fangs dripping acidic venom onto the floor.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing right hand across palm
panels.action: Ha-Jun runs his ring finger along his open palm, summoning a ribbon of glowing crimson blood.
The stream of blood swirls in an elegant vortex around his right forearm, thickening and hardening.
The fluid crystallizes with a glass-like chime, forming a 40-inch single-edged katana with dark crimson fuller.
Ha-Jun's fingers wrap around the crimson hilt, violet lightning crackling down the length of the red blade.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh talwar... mere haath ka hissa lagti hai. Koi wajan nahi, bilkul natural.

panels.action: Kuro flutters his wings in dark satisfaction: 'The Sanguine Fang... Sovereign ki pehli talwar!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ek bhi jhatka bekaar mat karna! Blood mana limit par hai!

panels.action: The second ghoul kicks off a wooden bookcase, jaw unhinging to bite off Ha-Jun's head.
Ha-Jun pivots smoothly on his left heel, the monster's teeth snapping mere millimeters past his face.
Ha-Jun executes a lightning-fast horizontal reverse slash, leaving a luminous red crescent arc in the air.
The ghoul's torso is cleanly sliced into two halves, dissolving into black ash before hitting the ground.
Seeing its packmate obliterated in one strike, the third ghoul turns and frantically scrambles toward the hatch.
Ha-Jun's crimson pupils dilate: 'Bhaagne nahi doonga.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar tum bahar gaye, toh innocent logon ko maar doge.

panels.action: Ha-Jun shifts into an athletic javelin stance, the blood katana vibrating with concentrated mana.

panels.shot: katana hurled like a crimson spear
panels.action: The blood blade launches through the air like a scarlet railgun beam, breaking the sound barrier.

panels.shot: blade pinning ghoul to steel door
panels.action: The blade impales the ghoul directly through the spine, pinning it three feet off the ground against the steel door.
The pinned demon disintegrates into black smoke and violet sparks, leaving only the embedded crimson blade.
The crystalline katana dissolves back into a stream of pure crimson liquid, flowing through the air.

panels.shot: blood stream returning to ha-jun ring
panels.action: The crimson stream spirals back into the Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger, reabsorbing completely.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Khoon wapas aa gaya... Toh main ise reuse kar sakta hoon!

panels.action: Kuro glides down onto the pedestal: 'Khoon barbad nahi hota jab tak tum conscious ho.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Lekin agar blade toot gaya ya evaporate hua, toh tumhara biological blood chala jayega.

panels.action: Ha-Jun flexes his fingers, feeling the thrill of combat power for the first time in his life.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pehli baar... mujhe lag raha hai ki main kamzor nahi hoon.

panels.shot: sudden vision flash in ha-jun head
panels.action: A violent psychic flash hits Ha-Jun's mind: an ancient battlefield covered in millions of crimson swords.

panels.shot: giant silhouette on throne of blades
panels.action: A titanic shadowy king with four demonic horns sits on an iron throne made of a thousand blood blades.
Deep thunderous voice resonating: 'My blood still cuts... my wrath still breathes.'

dialogue.text: "Mera khoon abhi bhi kaatta hai... mera krodh abhi bhi zinda hai."

panels.action: Ha-Jun stumbles backward, blinking rapidly as the dark vision shatters like stained glass.
From Ha-Jun's belt, Min-Jae's urgent voice crackles over the handheld radio.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Bureau ke 3 tactical vans Insa-dong alley mein enter kar chuki hain!

panels.action: Ha-Jun brings the radio to his lips: 'Main Relic le chuka hoon. Rasta batao.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main secure hoon. Exit 4 se bahar aa raha hoon.

panels.action: Min-Jae types frantically on his laptop in a parked delivery van outside, monitoring radar pings.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Tunnel ventilator B-3 open hai! Wahan se roof par niklo!

panels.action: Ha-Jun springs off an antique desk, kicking upward through the open ceiling ventilation shaft.
Kuro follows close behind in a streak of purple smoke, chuckling softly.
Ha-Jun bursts onto the rainy Seoul rooftop, city neon lights reflecting in his dual-ringed crimson eyes.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh toh bas shuruat hai. Abhi aath Relics baaki hain.
